note: MODULES WHOSE ROWS ARE OTHER PEOPLE'S DATA with no per-employee column to scope by, or that are tenant-wide logs, need more than the default employee.view that every employee login holds (owner, 28 Sep: an Employee/Agent sees only their own data).
